e-juice.intro: Shop regular (freebase) e-juice at Evolve Vapor in Pheasant Lane Mall — 60ml and 100ml bottles in 0mg, 3mg and 6mg from brands like Monster Vape Labs, Coastal Clouds, Twist, Naked 100, Candy King and Cloud Nurdz. Order online and pick up in store.
e-juice.more:
Regular e-juice at Evolve Vapor

Our E-Juice section is freebase e-liquid for sub-ohm tanks, mods and refillable pod kits. Most bottles are 60ml or 100ml, in 0mg, 3mg and 6mg nicotine, and most sell for about $10–$25. You'll find fruit, dessert, candy, menthol and tobacco flavors from Monster Vape Labs (Jam, Custard, Fruit and Frozen Fruit Monster), Coastal Clouds, Twist, Naked 100, Candy King, Cloud Nurdz, Juice Head, Innevape, Air Factory and more.

Looking for higher nicotine in a smaller bottle for a pod system? That's Salt Nicotine E-Juice. Not sure which fits your device? Our staff can help you pick at the store.
faq: What's the difference between e-juice and salt nicotine e-juice?

Regular e-juice uses freebase nicotine, usually 0–6mg, and is made for sub-ohm tanks and higher-wattage devices. Salt nicotine e-juice comes in higher strengths (about 20–50mg) in 30ml bottles and is made for low-wattage pod systems. We list them separately so you get the right one.
Can I order e-juice online and pick it up?
Yes. Order on the website and pick it up at Evolve Vapor in Pheasant Lane Mall, Nashua, NH. Bring a valid photo ID — you must be 21 or older.
What does "Regular" or "New" mean on a strength option?
"Regular" on an e-juice listing is 3mg. "New" means the maker updated the product code (SKU) for the same strength.

salt-nicotine.h1: Salt Nicotine E-Juice in Nashua, NH
salt-nicotine.intro: Nic salt e-juice for pod systems at Evolve Vapor in Pheasant Lane Mall — 30ml bottles in higher strengths from Pod Juice, Monster Vape Labs, Pachamama, Cloud Nurdz, Air Factory, Salt Bae, Juice Head and Candy King. Order online and pick up in store.
salt-nicotine.more:
Nic salts at Evolve Vapor

Salt nicotine e-juice (nic salt) is made for low-wattage pod systems and refillable pods. Bottles are usually 30ml, in strengths from about 20mg to 55mg depending on the brand, and most sell for about $10–$25. Popular lines include Pod Juice, Jam and Custard Monster Salts, Pachamama, Cloud Nurdz, Air Factory, Salt Bae, Juice Head, Candy King, Innevape, Twist and Naked 100 salts.

Nic salt is stronger than regular e-juice, so it isn't meant for sub-ohm tanks. For those, see E-Juice. Need a device for it? Browse Pods and Salt Nicotine Devices.
faq: What strengths do nic salts come in?
Most of our salt nicotine e-juice comes in about 20mg to 55mg, depending on the brand (for example 25mg and 50mg, or 35mg and 55mg). Each listing shows the strengths in stock.
Can I use nic salt in a sub-ohm tank?
It isn't recommended. Nic salt is made for low-wattage pod systems; for sub-ohm tanks, choose regular e-juice.
What does "Regular" mean on a salt listing?
On a salt nicotine listing, "Regular" is 35mg. "New" means the maker updated the product code (SKU) for the same strength.

pods.h1: Vape Pods & Cartridges in Nashua, NH
pods.intro: Replacement pods and cartridges at Evolve Vapor in Pheasant Lane Mall — Uwell Caliburn, SMOK Novo and Nord, Vaporesso XROS and LUXE, Voopoo, GeekVape, Suorin and more. Order online and pick up in store.
pods.more:
Pods and cartridges at Evolve Vapor

We stock refillable replacement pods and cartridges for popular pod systems, including Uwell Caliburn, SMOK Novo, Nord and RPM, Vaporesso XROS and LUXE, Voopoo, GeekVape, Suorin, Lost Vape and Innokin. Most sell for about $5–$26, in single pods and multi-packs, with different coil resistances where the maker offers them.

Check your device name on the pod listing to make sure it fits, or bring your device to the store and we'll match it. Pair them with Salt Nicotine E-Juice.
faq: How do I know which pod fits my device?
Match the device name and model on the listing (for example "Caliburn G" or "XROS"). If you're unsure, bring your device to the store and we'll find the right pod.
What does the ohm number on a pod mean?
It's the coil resistance. Higher resistance (around 0.8–1.2 ohm) is typical for a tighter, mouth-to-lung draw with nic salts; lower resistance is for a looser draw and lower-nicotine e-juice.

Replacement coils at Evolve Vapor

We carry replacement coils for popular tanks and pod systems from SMOK, FreeMax, Uwell, GeekVape, Aspire, Voopoo, Vaporesso, Horizon Tech and more, usually in packs, and most sell for about $5–$25. Coils are made for specific tanks, so match the series on the listing (for example TFV16, Fireluke or Cleito) to your tank.

Not sure which coil your tank takes? Bring it in and we'll match it. Also see Tanks and Pods.
faq: How often should I replace my coil?
It depends on how much you vape and the e-juice you use. A burnt taste or weaker flavor usually means it's time for a new coil.
Will these coils fit my tank?
Coils are made for specific tank series. Check that the listing names your tank, or bring your tank to the store and we'll match it.

faq: Pod kit or mod kit — which should I get?
Pod kits are small and simple and are usually used with nic salt. Mod kits give more power and bigger clouds and are used with regular e-juice. Our staff can help you choose.
Can you help me set up my kit?
Yes. Pick it up at the store and our staff can walk you through filling, priming the coil and settings.
